messages.content: [User Role: FARMER]
Hi, I just registered as a farmer on Auxin. Why does my dashboard say 'Pending Admin Approval'?

Welcome to Auxin! To maintain platform quality and food safety, all farmer accounts undergo administrative verification before listing produce. Once our team reviews your farm details and bank information, your account status will change to 'Approved', enabling you to add inventory and receive orders.
[User Role: FARMER]
What details do I need to submit to complete my farmer profile for verification?

To complete your farmer profile, please provide:
1. Your full name and contact phone number.
2. Bank details: Account Number, Account Holder Name, Bank Name, and IFSC Code (used for automated payout releases).
3. Farm Address details including area, city, pincode, and GPS coordinates for pickup routing.
Is my bank account number stored securely?

Yes, absolutely! Auxin encrypts all bank account numbers using Fernet symmetric encryption before storing them in our database. Your account information is decrypted only during automated payout releases.
[User Role: FARMER]
How do I set my farm's location so delivery partners can pick up orders?

Go to 'Farm Profile' under settings. Enter your farm's address details (House/Farm No., Street, Area, City, Pincode) and allow location access when prompted. This captures your exact latitude and longitude coordinates, which our courier routing system uses to calculate delivery routes and geofences.
[User Role: FARMER]
How does product listing work on Auxin V3.0?

Milo — The AI Assistant for Auxin. Auxin uses a Master Catalogue model. Admin manages canonical product categories and master items (e.g., 'Alphonso Mango', 'Red Tomato'). As a farmer, you don't need to create product names from scratch—you simply add your available harvest inventory under a Master Product!
What information do I specify when adding inventory?

When adding inventory under a master product, you set:
1. Price per unit (e.g. ₹40/kg)
2. Quantity available (e.g. 50 kg)
3. Unit of measure (from allowed units list, e.g. 'kg', '500g', 'bunch')
4. Harvest date
5. Organic certification status (`is_organic` flag)
6. Farming notes (e.g. 'Naturally ripened, Grade A').
[User Role: FARMER]
I harvested 100 kg of organic Tomatoes today. How do I add them to my inventory?

Navigating to your Farmer Dashboard, click 'Add Inventory'. Select 'Tomato' from the Master Product dropdown list. Set the price to your desired rate per kg, quantity to '100', unit to 'kg', check the 'Organic Certified' box, select today's harvest date, and tap 'Save Inventory'. Your stock will be aggregated and displayed immediately to local customers.
[User Role: FARMER]
The system gave me an error saying 'Unit Kilos is invalid' when I tried listing my potatoes.

Auxin uses standardized unit enums to maintain consistent pricing across the marketplace. Free-text unit entries like 'Kilos' or 'KG' are not accepted. Please select 'kg' from the allowed unit dropdown options (such as `kg`, `500g`, `250g`, `bunch`, `piece`, `litre`).
[User Role: FARMER]
My stock of Spinach ran out yesterday, but I harvested 30 fresh bunches today. How do I update it?

Go to 'My Inventory' on your Farmer Portal, locate 'Spinach', and click 'Edit Inventory'. Update the quantity field to '30', update the harvest date to today's date, and ensure the listing is toggled to 'Active'. Click 'Update'.
Will customers see the new harvest date?
Yes! The product listing will show the updated harvest date on the product detail page, reassuring customers that they are buying fresh morning harvest.
[User Role: FARMER]
Can I change the price of my produce after listing it?

Yes, you can adjust your listing price anytime under 'My Inventory'. Simply edit the price field and save. The new price will apply immediately to new orders placed after the change. Existing orders placed prior to the update will retain their locked purchase price.
[User Role: FARMER]
Why did my carrot listing automatically disappear from the customer marketplace after 30 days?

Auxin enforces an automatic 30-day harvest freshness policy. Any inventory batch with a harvest date older than 30 days is automatically hidden from public search to guarantee farm-fresh standards. If you have fresh stock, simply edit the listing with a new harvest date and updated quantity.
[User Role: FARMER]
I am going out of town for two days. How do I pause my listings so I don't receive orders?

You can toggle your active status from the top of your Farmer Dashboard, or open 'My Inventory' and switch your active listings to 'Inactive'. This immediately hides your stock from customer search without deleting your entries.
When I return, do I have to re-enter all my products?
Not at all! When you return, simply toggle your listings back to 'Active' (and update your harvest dates and quantities if needed). Your inventory will reappear in the marketplace instantly.
[User Role: FARMER]
What are the rules for marking a produce listing as 'Organic'?

You should check the `is_organic` box only if your produce is grown without synthetic pesticides, chemical fertilizers, or GMOs. Marking items accurately builds long-term customer trust. You can also add specific farming notes such as 'Natural vermicompost used, zero pesticides'.
[User Role: FARMER]
I want to sell Dragonfruit, but it is not listed in the Master Catalogue dropdown.

If a crop you grow is not in the Master Catalogue, click the 'Request New Product' button on your inventory screen. Fill in the requested product name ('Dragonfruit'), suggested category ('Fruits'), and default units ('kg' or 'piece').
How long does it take for the Admin to approve new master products?
Super Admin reviews catalogue requests within 24 hours. Once approved, 'Dragonfruit' will be added to the Master Catalogue, and you (and all local farmers) will be able to list stock under it!
[User Role: FARMER]
What happens to my inventory when a customer places an order?

Stock deduction is automatic and atomic. When a customer confirms an order for 5 kg of your produce, your `farmer_inventory.quantity` is immediately decremented by 5 kg. If an order is rejected or cancelled before delivery, the stock is automatically restored to your inventory.
[User Role: FARMER]
How do I know when a courier is coming to pick up an order from my farm?

When an order is placed and assigned, you will see it under 'Active Orders' on your Farmer Dashboard. The dashboard displays the assigned delivery partner's name, phone number, vehicle details, and estimated pickup time. Please package the items neatly for dispatch!
[User Role: FARMER]
When do I receive payment for orders fulfilled from my inventory?

Milo — The AI Assistant for Auxin. Payments are managed via an Escrow model. When an order is placed online, customer funds are held securely in escrow. As soon as the delivery partner delivers the package and validates the customer's OTP, the escrow release is automatically triggered, logging a 'release' transaction to your bank account.
Where can I view past payouts?
You can view all past payouts in your Farmer Portal under the 'Earnings' tab. It displays a full financial log including completed orders, transaction release IDs, and total revenue.
[User Role: FARMER]
I am a registered farmer. How do I log in to my dashboard?

To log in, open the Auxin app or website, go to the Auth page, select 'Sign In', select 'Farmer' role if prompted, enter your registered phone number (+91 format), and input your password. Upon authentication, you will be directed straight to your Farmer Dashboard.
[User Role: FARMER]
I operate a local dairy farm. How should I list Cow Milk and Paneer?

For Cow Milk, select 'Cow Milk' under the Dairy category, set your unit to 'litre' or '500ml', enter your quantity (e.g. 40 litres), set your price per unit, and enter today's milking/harvest date. For Paneer, list under 'Paneer' with units set to '250g' or '500g' or 'kg'.
[User Role: FARMER]
Should I sell fresh Coriander by weight (kg) or by bunch?

Both options are supported! You can select 'bunch' or 'kg' from the allowed units dropdown depending on how you harvest and package your coriander. Just make sure your price per unit reflects the unit type selected.
[User Role: FARMER]
How does Auxin display my price compared to other farmers?

Auxin aggregates inventory from all local farmers on the master product page. On the main marketplace card, it displays the lowest starting price ('From ₹X/kg'). When a customer clicks on the item, they can view a list of all individual farmers selling that produce, along with prices, organic badges, and harvest dates.
[User Role: FARMER]
I moved my primary harvesting location to a nearby farm. How do I update my farm location?

Navigate to settings in your Farmer Portal, select 'Farm Profile & Address', and update your farm house/survey number, street, pincode, and recalculate your GPS coordinates. Updating your location ensures delivery couriers route to the correct pickup origin.
[User Role: FARMER]
Do I need to upload a photo for every product I list?

No, uploading a photo is optional! Auxin provides high-quality canonical master images for every product in the Master Catalogue. If you don't upload a photo, the master product image will be displayed automatically. However, uploading your own harvest photo is recommended if you want to showcase unique organic batch qualities.
[User Role: FARMER]
The system gave an error when I tried setting price to 0.

Auxin enforces strict listing validation rules to protect data integrity: 1. Price must be greater than zero (`price > 0`). 2. Quantity cannot be negative (`quantity >= 0`). 3. Harvest date cannot be in the future. Please correct the price field and submit again.
[User Role: FARMER]
How long does farm verification take?

Administrative verification for new farmers is usually completed within 12 to 24 hours. During this period, our governance team validates your bank account details and location. You will receive an SMS notification as soon as your account is approved.
[User Role: FARMER]
I forgot my farmer account password. How do I reset it?

On the login screen, click 'Forgot Password?'. Enter your registered mobile phone number. A 6-digit OTP will be sent to your phone via SMS. Verify the code, enter your new password, and you can log straight back into your Farmer Portal.
[User Role: FARMER]
What should I do if I cannot fulfill an accepted order due to unexpected rain damage?

If crop damage prevents you from fulfilling an order, go to 'Active Orders' on your Farmer Dashboard and tap 'Reject Order', selecting 'Crop Damage' as the reason. The customer will be notified, their payment will be refunded from escrow, and your inventory count will be updated automatically.
[User Role: FARMER]
What are the valid units I can select for my produce?
Valid unit enums are: kg, 500g, 250g, 100g, litre, 500ml, 200ml, piece, dozen, bunch, pack. Each master product restricts options to standard units suitable for that item.
[User Role: FARMER]
Can stock quantity be negative?
No, stock quantity cannot be negative (`quantity >= 0`). If an item is out of stock, set quantity to 0.
[User Role: FARMER]
I don't have a photo of my Eggplant. Can I still list it?
Yes! Auxin automatically provides a high-quality canonical master image for 'Eggplant'. Uploading a photo is optional.
Thank you! Is there anything else I should know about managing my Eggplant inventory?
You're welcome, Rajashekar! Remember to keep your harvest dates up-to-date and maintain accurate stock numbers. Happy farming with Auxin!
[User Role: FARMER]

Master Catalogue prevents 10 different listings for the same crop (e.g. 'Tomato', 'Red Tomato', 'Fresh Tomato'). It groups all farmer harvests under one canonical item, giving buyers clear stock visibility and fair pricing!
